name: Registered To Patch Baseline
description: A patch group is registered with a patch baseline (patch group -> baseline): one DescribePatchGroups mapping, matched to the baseline's natural key; a group has one per operating system (ruling Q139b). A reference, not containment. Collected by the SSM baseline walk (collectors/boto3_collector/ssm_baselines.py, aws-core-tap#281, req-aws-core-ssm-baselines).
